descriptionChirho: Proper feminine noun designating the town of Sokho (also spelled Sochoh, Socoh, Sokhoh), a place name in the territory of Judah mentioned in contexts including the Philistine wars (1 Sam 17:1) and the Judahite town lists. All four clusters represent spelling and orthographic variants of the same toponym with minor prepositional or conjunction variation. Multilingual glosses confirm a single referent: Arabic سوكو/سُوكُوه (Soko/Sokoh), Spanish Soco/Socoh/Sokoh (variant spellings), Korean 소코/소고 (Soko/Sogo), Hindi सोको/सोकोह (Soko/Sokoh), Swahili Soko. No semantic polysemy -- purely orthographic and syntactic variants of one place name.
